transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... well, I guess I'm just having some issues at work lately. I manage a clinic, and... I don't know, I'll sit down to look at an EPIC quality report, or I'll be in a clinic metrics meeting, fully intending to track everything being said. But... within just a few minutes, my mind just drifts. 

I end up rereading the same numbers over and over, or I'll suddenly realize I missed the whole point of the discussion. So... that's what finally pushed me to make an appointment.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time lately?
Um... no. Not really. I wouldn't say I've been feeling sad.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
No. Not really. I mean... work is work, I guess, but I wouldn't say I feel anxious.
Do you have trouble focusing on tasks outside of work as well?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't really noticed it as much at home, I guess. It's mostly just... the clinic stuff.
How long have you been noticing this problem with your mind drifting at work?

Um... I guess it started after my promotion. That was about... two years and four months ago, I think. The portfolio got larger and... I don't know, the systems I used to rely on just started getting overwhelmed, I suppose.
Have you been feeling more tired than usual lately?
No, not really. I mean... just the normal amount, I suppose. I haven't noticed being unusually tired.
Do you often feel guilty about your performance at work lately?
I don't know... I mean, I guess I just try to do my job. I wouldn't really say I feel guilty, exactly. Just... trying to keep up.
Have you been having trouble remembering things that you would normally be able to recall?
Um... no, not really. My memory seems fine, I think. I haven't noticed any issues with that.
Have you been enjoying activities or hobbies that you typically find pleasurable?
Um... yeah, I suppose so. I still like doing the things I usually do. I haven't really noticed any change with that.
Have you noticed a decrease in interest in activities or things you usually enjoy?
No, I think I just answered that. My interests are... they're the same as they've been. I haven't really noticed a decrease.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things even when there's no obvious reason to worry?
No, not really. I mean... I don't think I worry about things unless there's an actual reason to. Just the normal amount, I guess.
Have you felt less interested in social activities or spending time with friends and family lately?
No... I still see my family and friends the same amount. There hasn't been any change there either.
Have you been feeling like your difficulty focusing at work is significantly affecting your overall well-being or daily life?

I suppose it is, yes. Um... at the clinic, my delays with getting things done have started affecting our reporting deadlines. It's... making other teams have to wait on me. And I've had to step back from leading some of the volunteer health workshops I usually do. I just... I can't seem to reliably keep all the planning pieces moving right now.
Do you find yourself worrying about things at work or in other areas of your life even when things are going well?
No... I don't think so. Um, like I mentioned earlier, I really only worry if there's an actual problem. If things are going well, I don't... I just leave it be.
Do you find yourself frequently worrying about things in a way that feels hard to control?
No, not really. Like I said... I don't tend to worry unless there's a reason to. It's not something I struggle to control.
Have you experienced any significant changes in your appetite or sleep patterns lately?
Um, no. I haven't noticed anything like that. My sleep is about the same... and my appetite is fine.
Do you have trouble focusing when you're doing things you enjoy or find interesting?
No. If it's something I actually like doing, I don't really have a problem focusing on it. It's just... the other stuff.
Do you have trouble focusing on tasks when you're by yourself, outside of work and outside of activities you enjoy?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't noticed it being an issue. I just... do whatever needs getting done around the house, I guess. I haven't paid much attention to it.
Do you think you worry more than most people about everyday things?
I don't think so. I mean, I worry about normal things, but... not more than anyone else, I don't think.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things for a long time, even after you've dealt with them?
Not really. Once something is handled, it's handled. I don't really dwell on it after that.
